questions.question: Which Article of the Constitution of India guarantees the Right to Life and Personal Liberty?
questions.mentorScolding: Focus! Article 21 is life and liberty. You just lost a heart and your streak. Try again!

questions.question: The Right to Education was made a Fundamental Right (Article 21A) by which Constitutional Amendment?
questions.mentorScolding: Sloppy. The 86th Amendment gave us Article 21A. Dates and numbers win this exam. You lost a heart. Recover.

questions.question: Who described Article 32, the Right to Constitutional Remedies, as the heart and soul of the Constitution?
questions.mentorScolding: Unacceptable. Ambedkar called Article 32 the heart and soul. This is a one-mark gift and you dropped it. Streak gone. Rebuild.

questions.question: Who appoints the Prime Minister of India?
questions.mentorScolding: Wrong. The President appoints the Prime Minister. Basic structure, basic marks. Heart lost. Do not repeat this.

questions.question: Which Article vests the executive power of the Union in the President?
questions.mentorScolding: Careless. Article 53 is the executive power of the Union. Article 52 only says there shall be a President. Read the wording. Streak broken.

questions.question: What is the minimum age to be eligible for election as President of India?
questions.mentorScolding: No. Thirty-five years for the President. Eligibility numbers repeat every year in this exam. Lock it in.

questions.question: The Directive Principles of State Policy are contained in which Part of the Constitution?
questions.mentorScolding: Part IV. Part III is Fundamental Rights. Mixing them up costs marks every single year. Heart gone. Focus.

questions.question: Which Article directs the State to secure a Uniform Civil Code for citizens?
questions.mentorScolding: Article 44. Uniform Civil Code. You have seen this question before and still missed it. That is a discipline problem. Try again.

questions.question: Who presides over a joint sitting of both Houses of Parliament?
questions.mentorScolding: The Speaker of Lok Sabha presides over the joint sitting. Know who holds the chair. Heart lost. Streak reset.

questions.question: What is the maximum permissible gap between two sessions of Parliament?
questions.mentorScolding: Six months. Not a day more between sessions. Vague memory is not preparation. Sharpen up.
